speaker: Keeper
text: David, your father is waiting in the courtyard. I will watch the flock while you go to him.

speaker: David
text: Thank you. Keep them near the water. I will go to my father.

speaker: Jesse
text: David, my son. Come here. I have an errand for you.

speaker: David
text: I am here, Father. What would you have me do?

speaker: Jesse
text: Take this roasted grain and these loaves to your brothers at the camp. Take these cheeses to their commander. See how your brothers are, and bring me word of them.

speaker: David
text: I will go, Father. I will take the provisions and bring you news of my brothers.

speaker: Jesse
text: Go, my son. May the Lord be with you.
